project_type: Full-stack blockchain dApp: Hardhat (Solidity) smart contract + Express.js backend + React/Vite frontend with ethers.js wallet integration
build_system: npm workspaces (root package.json coordinates blockchain/, backend/, frontend/ subdirectories); Hardhat for contract compilation; Vite for frontend bundling
test_framework: Hardhat test framework (test/*.js in blockchain/); no frontend tests in current setup
build_command: npm run compile (from blockchain/) to compile Solidity; npm run build (from frontend/) to bundle React; backend runs directly with node (no build step)
test_command: npm run test (from blockchain/) runs Hardhat tests; frontend has no tests; backend has no tests (startup verification sufficient for demo)
verification_instructions: 1. From blockchain/: npm run compile (verifies .sol syntax and ABI generation). 2. From root or blockchain/: npm run node (start Hardhat local network), then npm run deploy:local (writes contract to frontend/src/contracts/contractInfo.json). 3. From backend/: npm start (starts API on port 3001, connects to contract via RPC_URL). 4. From frontend/: npm run dev (starts React dev server on localhost:5173). 5. Manually test: register batch, transfer, add update via UI or curl; verify GET /api/batches/:id returns correct data; run integrity check on /api/batches/:id/history.
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/src/contracts/contractInfo.json (contract address + ABI, generated by deploy.js). No other snapshot/generated files checked in. backend/ uses SQLite database file tracepath.db (local file, not checked in) for off-chain metadata.
environment_constraints: Never commit .env files (contain PRIVATE_KEY, RPC_URL secrets). Hardhat node runs on localhost:8545 (hardcoded in hardhat.config.js); frontend dev server on localhost:5173 (Vite default); backend on port 3001 (configurable via .env PORT). On Windows, use PowerShell for startup scripts. MetaMask chain ID 31337 for local network, chain ID 11155111 for Sepolia.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md present; infer from README: (1) follow the setup sequence (install → node → deploy:local → dev); (2) do not commit private keys; (3) use only local test accounts for demo; (4) code must be syntax-correct and runnable without user intervention after npm install and env setup.
key_patterns: Contract uses keccak256(batchId) as key for mappings; events emit batchId + eventHash for indexing. App.jsx uses useState for form state and useEffect for wallet connect/load-batches side effects. CSS is hand-written minified single-line (index.css); no Tailwind yet. Frontend directly imports contractInfo.json and constructs ethers.Contract instance. deploy.js writes contractInfo.json to both frontend/src/contracts/ (main) and will also write to backend/src/contracts/ (new, for backend to read ABI). MetaMask signing happens client-side in App.jsx; backend will receive signed tx data via POST body or return unsigned tx data for client to sign.
relevant_files: blockchain/contracts/TracePath.sol (study for event hash chain logic and function signatures)
blockchain/scripts/deploy.js (modify to also write to backend/)
frontend/src/App.jsx (refactor contract calls → API calls, keep wallet signing flow)
frontend/src/index.css (layer Tailwind utilities over existing custom styles)
backend/src/server.js (new: Express app, routes, chain verification)
backend/src/contracts/contractInfo.json (new: symlink or copy from frontend, read by backend)
backend/package.json (new: express, better-sqlite3, qrcode, dotenv, cors, ethers)
backend/.env.example (new: CONTRACT_ADDRESS, RPC_URL, CHAIN_ID, PORT, FRONTEND_URL)
TracePath/package.json (new root: install:all, dev, build scripts)
TracePath/start-demo.ps1 (new: PowerShell script to start hardhat node, backend, frontend in parallel)
directory_structure: TracePath/ (root) → blockchain/ (Hardhat + Solidity), frontend/ (React/Vite), backend/ (Express, SQLite, new). No src/ at root; each subdirectory is self-contained npm project. Monorepo scripts in root package.json coordinate multi-process startup.
